g.text: Bi-directional outbound dial-out architecture: bypass NAT without open ports or vendor lock
No cloud vendor access to terminal bytes
Rendezvous ID table matches pairing tokens
Drop dead sessions immediately on ping timeout
No persistent disk storage of terminal output
No router port forwarding or UPnP
Survives IP changes and laptop sleep
Closing GUI never kills terminal jobs
Ring buffer replays missed terminal bytes
Agent workspaces in isolated git worktrees
Full shell isolation from public internet
ARCHITECTURE: OUTBOUND RENDEZVOUS • NO INBOUND PORTS • FULL DATA SOVEREIGNTY
